objective.primaryRule: NL0 1.0.0 §3.5 original rule: the actual-profit role among the Q1-Q6 qualified members (highest centre net; ties: higher selection robust net, lower centre DD, label), per arm population (D, G, C, J, S) at every cutoff; RA1 report-only. The determination (PROTOCOL.md §12: (a) Q1-Q6, (b) chronological support, (c) V1-V3, (d) ES1-ES3) is a separate precommitted governance label.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 initial trading allocation (not peak account equity); P0 = 35 % of it; trade principal loss, banked-capital DD and giveback are report-only

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals: the configured base broad lanes x (512 screen + 2 x 256 island) per cutoff — D 64, G 144, J 384, S 18 x 18 lanes (F = 3) — over 4 cutoffs, before refinement designs, extension islands and replicate rounds (PROTOCOL.md §7.6). Backend evaluations: the hard ceiling of 250,000,000 requested official evaluations (archive hits included; fresh and hits reported separately; ledger over the sealed stage records); deterministic per-lane bounds (budget.ts laneCaps), 650/652 per qualified member, 306 per slice subject; the pilot's expected effort in the freeze record.

evaluationBackend.notes: Every official evaluation (searches, replicate rounds, qualification, fold slices, validation) runs only through openOfficialGpuSession -> GpuPool -> EvalLab on the accepted GPU Phase 9 evaluator (record sha256 9ebb33ce8620dead..., binary gb9 36dcc251..., RTX 5090 GPU-ae5f222c...), node --no-maglev, one held job per stage; no CPU fallback. Engineering gates, data tools, the pilot and report-only diagnostics are non-official (parity-test / benchmark / diagnostic).

chronologicalConsequence: Standard §1.8 default, adopted: a failed or uncomputable independent verdict of an arm's procedure means 'no chronological support: the selection is not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision' (brief Phase 5F: development-qualified only, not independently deployment-qualified). Governance only. 'No qualifying MSFT candidate' is a valid outcome. There is no informed lane.

deviations.description: The MSFT space: P6-TSLA's / P8-GDX's space unchanged (Assignment 3's genome semantics on the one trading slot; the accepted engine's VGT slot carries MSFT; the GDX-named slot's books disabled; no evaluation file changed); arms D (8 D1 cells), G (6 Growth exit-protection cells), J (48), S (frozen D1 x 6), C (fixed pairs). S1 absent; shadow eligibility OFF; calendar-day holds.
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 2 (five arms, existing allocator and semantics; S1 and shadow eligibility OFF).

deviations.description: Effort by replicates of NL0's unchanged per-lane schedules: P8-GDX's executed allocation x 4/3 in every stage and Growth's base replicates x 2 — base D 8, G 24, J 8, S R_S(F) = max(8, ceil(320 / (6F))) = 18 for F = 3; 8 refinement lanes per refined cell — with Priority 5's two-tier island rule and convergence-driven replicate rounds (<= 4, 2 %).
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 3 items 2-5 and Phase 5 (substantial, fairly allocated effort, multiple seeds, do not starve Growth or the joint arm); P8-GDX's measured Growth seed dispersion 49-63 %; NL0 §7.4 scaling.

deviations.description: Priority 5's exact sequential drawdown statistic from GPU marks; one procedure per arm.
deviations.justification: The accepted GPU path returns no minute mark series; a CPU-scored official statistic is forbidden (§9.2).

deviations.description: NL0's original rule is THE selector; RA1 computed on the identical populations as a separately labelled report-only experimental selector (never selects).
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 2 (the original NL0/P0 selector remains the official selector) and Phase 3 item 6.

deviations.description: Method comparison: C (separately optimized, pooled), J (joint), S (D1-first sequential), with D and G standalone; matched rules; effort matched by the frozen R_S rule (S + its D1 step >= J) and disclosed per arm.
deviations.justification: Brief Mission item 4, Phase 2, Phase 3 item 2.

deviations.description: Assignment 3's instrument on the MSFT slot in this study's seed namespace, common random numbers across centres and arms; arm S's design neighbourhoods never move the frozen D1.
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 2 arm S (D1 parameters must not move).

deviations.description: Priority 5's eight stresses (cost 0/2/10/20 bps, 14 % interest, stop slippage +10/+25 bps, next-open stops).

Precommitted determination: finalists, development, chronological and sufficiency labels sealed before FULL; architecture comparisons with Priority 5's bands ($10,000 / $5,000 / $2,500) and replication; the outcome joins validation records by (arm, id) and fails closed; 'no qualifying MSFT candidate' valid.
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 0 (outcome identity), Phase 3 item 10, Phase 5F.

deviations.description: D1 hold-window tail stress on pre-2016 MSFT daily data (1986-03-13 -> 2015-12-31, Yahoo split-adjusted closes; disjoint) plus in-sample.
The common complete endpoint is 2026-10-30 (R1's validation end; the program's); no later MSFT row was downloaded.

No MSFT incumbent: no informed lane or population; New L0's and N/original's VGT books are external controls only (never seeds, members or finalists); NL0's informed-lane budget reassigned to the stage-2 refinement.
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 0 (independent MSFT search, references isolated and labelled).

deviations.description: Combined arms require both MSFT books funded (Q6); protected and unrestricted Growth structures protected by cells and reported as sub-populations.
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 2 (protected and unrestricted alternatives fairly represented) and Phase 5B.

deviations.description: MSFT has no split in the window: the doors apply the central split ledger (no MSFT event; an event fails closed). Price-only convention unchanged; dividends reported, never credited.
Buy-and-hold comparators (financed/unfinanced; price-only/with dividends) and per-lot dividend entitlement are report-only, after the outcome.

Evidence-sufficiency thresholds ES1-ES3 bind the final candidate determination (never the search, Q1-Q6, ranking or selection): >= 10 funded lots (C, J, S also >= 3 of each family), >= 5 independent pool-level episodes and funded entries in >= 4 calendar years, largest winning episode <= 50 % of the development net; a primary failing them is not a research candidate.
deviations.justification: The brief asks for precommitted trade/episode/concentration thresholds that are not lowered for MSFT; §2.6 forbids activity floors and largest-winner caps from eliminating candidates, so binding them on the candidate label departs from it.

No qualified candidate is an acceptable finding.'; Phase 5B: 'Do not let a single enormous winner satisfy robustness requirements by itself.'
